Name: TC-103: Traffic analytics page loads and URL is /traffic-analytics
Description: Navigates to /traffic-analytics and verifies the URL and page title are present.

Name: TC-114: Valid date range filters results to that window
Description: Sets a date range covering today. Expects results (seeded data was just posted) and no date error. Active filter count must be 2 (from + to).

Name: TC-121: Unauthenticated access to /traffic-analytics redirects to /signin
Description: Deletes all cookies then navigates to /traffic-analytics. Angular auth guard must redirect.

Name: TC-117: Changing page size re-fetches with the new per-page count
Description: Changes the per-page select to 10 and verifies the row count is <= 10 and the record-count label is still present.

Name: TC-082: Density line and speed bar charts match the trends API
Description: Seeds a reading, refreshes, waits for charts to render, then reads the trends API newest record and the UI leftmost dot/bar (both = newest reading after Angular reversal) and asserts they match.

Name: TC-076: Recent alerts section shows at most 5 alerts
Description: The TS component slices to the latest 5. Count must never exceed 5.

Name: TC-091: Traffic alerts page loads and URL is /traffic-alerts
Description: Navigates to /traffic-alerts and verifies URL and page title.

Name: TC-101: Pagination shows when alerts exceed page size of 15
Description: Verifies pagination controls appear with non-zero rows when total > 15.

Name: TC-062: 'Traffic Monitoring Dashboard' page title is displayed
Description: Verifies the .page-title element is visible.

Name: TC-119: Back link navigates to /traffic dashboard
Description: Clicks the back arrow and verifies navigation to /traffic.

Name: TC-064: Analytics nav link navigates to /traffic-analytics
Description: Clicks the Analytics header nav link.

Name: TC-070: Data table is visible with at least 1 row after seeding
Description: Three readings posted in @BeforeMethod — table must have at least 1 row.

Name: TC-078: Manual refresh keeps dashboard on /traffic without error
Description: Clicks the manual refresh icon. Dashboard must stay on /traffic and show no error.

Name: TC-107: Filtering by 'High' congestion returns only High rows or empty state
Description: Selects High from the congestion dropdown and searches. If results exist, every congestion badge must say High.

Name: TC-065: Alerts nav link navigates to /traffic-alerts
Description: Clicks the Alerts header nav link.

Name: TC-108: Filtering by location 'Alexandria' returns only Alexandria rows
Description: Types 'Alexandria' into #filterLocation and searches. All visible location cells must contain 'Alexandria'. The simulator and @BeforeMethod both post to Alexandria so results are guaranteed.

Name: TC-094: 'Traffic Density' metric filter scopes results
Description: Selects Traffic Density from #aFilterMetric. All metric cells must read 'Traffic Density'.

Name: TC-063: Back link navigates to /home
Description: Clicks .back-link and verifies navigation to /home.

Name: TC-092: Alerts table shows rows or empty state — no error banner
Description: Two readings crossed thresholds in @BeforeMethod. Table must show rows with no error.

Name: TC-061: Traffic dashboard loads and URL is /traffic
Description: Navigates to /traffic and verifies the URL contains /traffic but not a sub-route.

Name: TC-097: Invalid date range shows validation error
Description: End date before start date — expects .filter-date-error.

Name: TC-110: Active filter badge appears after applying a congestion filter
Description: Applies a Moderate congestion filter and verifies the .filter-active-indicator badge appears. The badge text should contain '1 active'.

Name: TC-095: 'Average Speed' metric filter scopes results
Description: Selects Average Speed from #aFilterMetric. All metric cells must read 'Average Speed'.

Name: TC-116: Pagination controls appear and next page works when data spans multiple pages
Description: If more than 20 records exist (default page size), pagination is shown. Clicks Next and verifies the active page number increases and rows are still present.

Name: TC-106: Filtering by 'Moderate' congestion scopes all visible rows
Description: Selects Moderate from #filterCongestion and clicks Search. All visible .congestion-badge elements must read 'Moderate'. The seeded Moderate reading (density=277) guarantees at least one result.

Name: TC-066: 'Analytics & Search' quick action navigates to /traffic-analytics
Description: Clicks the Analytics & Search quick-action-btn.

Name: TC-109: Filtering by non-existent location shows empty state
Description: Types a location that does not exist in the data. Expects the empty state.

Name: TC-067: 'Traffic Alerts' quick action navigates to /traffic-alerts
Description: Clicks the Traffic Alerts quick-action-btn.

Name: TC-113: Invalid date range (end before start) shows validation error
Description: Sets end date before start date using JavaScript (required for datetime-local inputs in Chrome). Clicks Search. Expects .filter-date-error to appear.

Name: TC-098: Mark All Read button appears only when unread alerts exist
Description: .btn-mark-all only rendered when unreadCount > 0. Verifies presence matches unread rows.

Name: TC-079: Auto-refresh toggle disables then re-enables
Description: btn-auto-refresh.active by default. Toggling removes then restores the class.

Name: TC-077: 'View All Alerts' link navigates to /traffic-alerts
Description: Clicks the View All Alerts anchor in the recent alerts section.

Name: TC-074: Congestion distribution shows exactly 4 level rows
Description: Expects 4 .congestion-row elements: Low, Moderate, High, Severe.

Name: TC-068: Stats section shows exactly 5 stat cards
Description: Stats section must be visible with exactly 5 non-skeleton stat cards.

Name: TC-069: All 5 stat card values are loaded and non-empty
Description: Three readings were seeded in @BeforeMethod. All stat values must be non-empty.

Name: TC-080: Unauthenticated /traffic access redirects to /signin
Description: Deletes all cookies then navigates to /traffic. Angular auth guard must redirect.

Name: TC-100: Back link navigates to /traffic dashboard
Description: Clicks .back-link and verifies /traffic.

Name: TC-111: Applying two filters shows badge with count 2
Description: Applies both a location filter and a congestion filter. Badge must show '2 active'.

Name: TC-099: Every alert row has a severity badge of High, Medium, or Low
Description: Iterates .severity-badge and asserts each is High, Medium, or Low.

Name: TC-112: Reset removes the active filter badge and restores full results
Description: Applies a filter, records filtered count, clicks Reset, then verifies the badge disappears and the total count is >= the filtered count.

Name: TC-071: Pagination controls appear when data exceeds page size
Description: Checks that when more than 10 records exist pagination controls are shown.

Name: TC-096: Reset clears metric filter and restores full list
Description: Applies density filter, records count, resets, verifies count >= filtered count.

Name: TC-075: Recent alerts section is displayed
Description: High-density and low-speed readings crossed thresholds, so at least one alert should exist. Section must show alerts or the empty state — not an error.

Name: TC-104: Default load shows results with no active filter badge
Description: On initial open with no filters applied, the table must show rows (data was seeded in @BeforeMethod) and no .filter-active-indicator badge should appear.

Name: TC-118: First table row values match the latest record from the API
Description: Opens the analytics page (which loads with sort=timestamp,desc by default), reads the API first record and the UI first row at the same moment, and asserts location, density, speed, and congestion level match.

Name: TC-115: Changing sort order re-fetches results without error
Description: Selects 'trafficDensity,desc' from the sort dropdown and searches. Expects results present with no error banner, and the active filter badge reflects the non-default sort.

Name: TC-102: Unauthenticated /traffic-alerts access redirects to /signin
Description: Deletes cookies then navigates to /traffic-alerts. Auth guard must redirect.

Name: TC-120: Alerts nav link navigates to /traffic-alerts
Description: Clicks the Alerts link in the header nav bar.

Name: TC-105: Record count label shows a positive number
Description: The .record-count span must show a positive integer after data was seeded.

Name: TC-073: Charts section is visible with at least 3 chart cards
Description: Density line, speed bar, and congestion distribution charts must all be present.

Name: TC-093: All visible type badges have class type-traffic
Description: This page only shows Traffic alerts. No Air or Light type badges should appear.

Name: TC-081: Real-Time Traffic Data table first row matches the latest API record
Description: Seeds a reading, refreshes the dashboard, waits for table to re-render, then reads the API and UI at the same moment and asserts they match.

Name: TC-072: Clicking Next page changes the active page indicator
Description: Only runs when pagination is available. Verifies active page number increases.
